title: Why Workers Sending Money Home Beat Big Investment
hook: Your family's money home is part of a $685 billion flood.
closing: The biggest lifeline to poorer countries isn't government aid. It's ordinary workers sending money home.
question: Ever sent money home? Tell me below.

segments.say: Migrants sent home $685 billion in 2024. Even the pandemic barely dented it, so families clearly count on this money.
India alone got $120 billion from its migrants in a single year. The runner-up got barely over half that.
In 2023, remittances beat foreign company investment by over $270 billion. Workers' paychecks outweighed big business money.
